[/b][color=#d9ead3][size=4][b]UPDATE:[/b] Milo is now included in a larger mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15164/]Cindersnap Circle[/url]﻿, where I will add more NPC's later on! This changes the location of his home and should fix most compatibility issues! [b]DO NOT download both this version, and the Cindersnap Circle versions of Milo[/b], as they will not work together![/size][/color]
﻿﻿[/center]Say 'Hello' to Pelican Town's resident R&B musician and fashion connesieur, Milo! He likes to think of himself as a laid-back and humorous kind of guy, but some days he can be pretty negative and hot-tempered. Despite living in Pelican Town for a few years now, he still feels like an outsider to the relaxed country life he's found himself in. Life moves so much slower than he's use to, and he's severely underestimated how many [i]bugs [/i]would invade his home in Cindersnap Forest. Still, he'd given up the big city life for a reason, so he's determined to find his place in the town while also continuing to produce his own music.

﻿Will Pelican Town's newest farmer be the friend he needed to become the person he wants to be? Or, could they be something more? Get to know Milo through his customized home and schedule, randomized dialogue options, and festival locations! 

[b][color=#cfe2f3]Installation:[/color]
[/b]- In﻿stall SMAPi and Content Patcher
- Download and extract the [CP]Milo folder into your Mods folder
- Enjoy!

[b][color=#cfe2f3]Requirements:[/color][/b]
- Requires SMAPI  and Content Patcher to run
- NEWER VERSIONS NO LONGER REQUIRE THE TMX SPOUSE ROOM AND FESTIVAL LOCATION FILES

[color=#cfe2f3]﻿[b]Compatibility:[/b][/color]
- I'm not sure if this mod is compatible with SVE, but I don't believe it is. 
- Incompatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10697?tab=description]Alec 
[/url]- Incompatible with mods that edit Cindersnap Forest, but [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15164]Cindersnap Circle[/url] is an alternative that may work. ﻿
- It should be compatible with most other NPC mods, but let me know if there are any issues.

[b][color=#cfe2f3]Known Issues:[/color] [/b]
- This is my first time making a mod, so there's bound to be a lot of mistakes. But, here are some I already know of:
﻿- Milo's house textures glitch out in different seasons (especially in Summer).
﻿ ﻿- This will be fixed when I eventually go back and make a better house for him. For now I mostly used tiles from marnie's house. 
﻿- The heart events past six are [b]UNFINISHED[/b]! They may begin and end, but that's about as far as I've gotten. This mod is still a work in progress, so this will ﻿  likely be fixed in later updates. 
﻿- I'm in the process of testing marriage with him, so there may be a lot of issues in that aspect. I just added the details for this very recently. 

[color=#cfe2f3][b]Notes:[/b][/color]

[color=#d9ead3]Thank you so much to everyone who has reached out and helped me refine this mod and come up with ideas for improving it!! A special thanks to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/110631873]0Renciel[/url] For helping to edit Milo's files to be more compatible![/color]

- Birthday: Winter 22
- Loved Gifts: Maki Roll, Ice Cream, Wine, Stir Fry, and Peaches
- Liked Gifts: Cherries, Jack O' Lanterns, Midnight Squid, Fairy Roses, and Blue Jazz's
- Does NOT like bugs or tomatoes. (Seriously, he has enough bug meat on his shoes)
- Will have 10 heart events (WIP)**
[b]﻿- There are currently six heart events that are completed, but 8 and 10 are still incomplete!!![/b]
- There is a spouse room that should work, but I have only done limited testing!
- Has different schedules depending on the day and season.
